decisions.scenario: Finding a Sunday train from Cambridge to Peterborough and checking an east-side hotel

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'm planning a trip in Cambridge.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: That sounds like fun. What information can I help you find?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I need a train from Cambridge to Peterborough on Sunday that arrives by 21:45.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: What station will you be departing from?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'll be departing from Cambridge. I need the departure time, train ID, and fare.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Train TR6958 leaves Cambridge at 20:34 and arrives in Peterborough at 21:24. The fare is £13.20.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thanks. I'm also looking for a place to stay in the east.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Express by Holiday Inn Cambridge is a two-star expensive hotel in the east with free parking and internet. Its address is 15–17 Norman Way, Coldhams Business Park.

decisions.notes: Retained because TR6958's Sunday Cambridge-to-Peterborough schedule and £13.20 fare add source-backed train coverage not present in the existing reviewed set; the accompanying hotel details remain source-backed.
